entries.heading: Verse 1
entries.text: Ps 121:1-8 . God's guardian care of His people celebrated.
2. by avowing God to be the helper, of whose ability His creative power is a pledge ( Ps 115:15 ), to which,
3, 4. His sleepless vigilance is added. to be moved --(Compare Ps 38:16; 66:9 ).

entries.heading: 5. upon thy right hand
entries.text: 5. upon thy right hand --a protector's place ( Ps 109:31; 110:5 ).
6-8. God keeps His people at all times and in all perils. nor the moon by night --poetically represents the dangers of the night, over which the moon presides ( Ge 1:16 ).

entries.heading: 8. thy going out,
entries.text: 8. thy going out, &c.--all thy ways ( De 28:19; Ps 104:23 ). evermore --includes a future state.
